verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic implements two multi-party agentic protocols, ACP and UCP, rather than a proprietary scheme. Its docs name several independent counterparties it interoperates with: Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot, Google AI Mode, OpenAI and Meta. That indicates an ecosystem rather than a private integration. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that ACP/UCP are openly specified and implemented by other parties (not just named as integration targets), and independent or third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
